prompts.androgynous: Use case: precise-object-edit. EDIT TARGET image 1 is a transparent 1600x1200 sprite source sheet containing ORIGINAL painted fragments. Image 2 is the original adult androgynous character painting, context/reference only. Complete the missing portions of these same painted parts, preserving the visible painted pixels, their coordinates, scale, shading, and direction. Do not redesign the body or rearrange cells. This is an animation asset repair, not an illustration of a person. EXACT GRID: 4 columns, each 400px wide; 2 rows each 600px high. TOP row right-facing parts, BOTTOM row left-facing parts. Columns from left: HAND, TORSO, HIPS, LOWER THIGH. Keep each fragment fixed and paint only missing/occluded skin adjoining it within its cell. HAND: complete palm, back of hand, thumb, all fingers, wrist overlap, full natural painted outer contour; remove no visible fingers; no circular crop or vertical chop. TORSO: remove arm remnants, paint behind the arm; complete back/spine curve with original dark outline, full painted chest/abdomen and natural shading, rounded painted overlap extending below the waist instead of a horizontal cutoff. HIPS: one contiguous pelvis/buttock plus first 20% of both upper thighs; preserve buttock curve, under-cheek fold and shading, remove all arm/hand remnants; complete hidden front and inner skin. No half-circle bumps or rectangle. LOWER THIGH: paint complete narrower thigh below the hips with soft organic proximal overlap, complete two side contours, no hand/finger remnants, notches or zigzag texture. Adjacent torso and hips must share matching waist shading and at least 8 native pixels of skin overlap when registered. Only intended exterior contour is outlined; hidden overlap ends blend without dark straight seams. Organic painted forms matching image 2 exactly, no gradients replacing paint, no geometric caps, no rotated-copy patterns, no text, no labels, no background, no extra limbs. Transparent background, fully opaque painted interiors, crisp antialiased exterior. Preserve the sheet size and cell registration; do not enlarge or recenter parts. Keep original neutral gray sculptural paint.
